summary: Fixes Notification.archive so a value casting to nil (empty string from archive_selected or API) archives instead of writing archived = NULL via update_all.

statements.why: The commit fixes a data bug; no login/payment/db-schema/secret problem introduced.

statements.text: The agent changed app/models/notification.rb in a way plain can't describe yet.
statements.why: notification.rb:80-81 really changed archive behavior; unexplained.

misses.what: Bug fix: a request with empty 'value' used to set archived NULL so notifications vanished from both Inbox and Archive; now they are archived.
Notifications already stuck with archived = NULL are not repaired.
